look.why: A warm Kalahari apricot-peach pastel that evokes red desert sands and complements the sandy-tan banded coat.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 0.5 m (body 25–35 cm plus 17–25 cm slender tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Arid open savannas, scrublands and Kalahari desert plains across southern Africa.

diet.text: Beetles, scorpions, spiders, centipedes, lizards, small snakes, eggs and desert tubers.

facts.text: While the mob digs for insects, one sentry stands upright on its tail and calls distinct alarms for eagles versus jackals.
Dark rings around its eyes act like built-in sunglasses against the bright Kalahari sun.

id.habitat: Sabana terbuka yang kering, semak belukar, dan dataran gurun Kalahari di Afrika bagian selatan.
id.diet: Kumbang, kalajengking, laba-laba, kelabang, kadal, ular kecil, telur, dan umbi-umbian gurun.
facts: Saat kawanan menggali mencari serangga, satu penjaga berdiri tegak bertumpu pada ekornya dan menyerukan peringatan berbeda untuk elang maupun jakal.
Lingkaran hitam di sekitar matanya berfungsi seperti kacamata hitam alami terhadap terik matahari Kalahari.
